answer: Honest agents build a reputation signal over epochs, tracked in a shared atlas of verified identities. Sybil resistance through stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond that is slashed if peers detect duplicate behavior. Any new registration must show a positive delta in unique behavioral entropy versus existing clusters, making mass fake accounts costly since each bond risks real loss and cloning patterns are flagged. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
